FFmpeg n8.1.3  —  Source and Build Information
=================================================

Component : FFmpeg
Version   : n8.1.3-24-g92611900bb-20261024  (based on FFmpeg 8.1 "Hoare")
License   : GNU Lesser General Public License v3.0 or later (LGPL-3.0-or-later)
Build     : win64-lgpl  (BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds, 64-bit Windows, LGPL v3 configuration)
Used by   : KtDownload  —  HLS (m3u8) remux to MP4
Integration: external process via ProcessBuilder (NOT linked; see README.md)

    https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds/releases/download/autobuild-2026-10-24-13-02/ffmpeg-n8.1.3-24-g92611900bb-win64-lgpl-8.1.zip

Redistribution by this project
------------------------------
The upstream deleted the autobuild tag above and renamed the repo to
FFmpeg-Builds/FFmpeg-Builds, so the historical URL returns 404. KtDownload
redistributes the exact same verified binary (SHA-256 unchanged) as a Release
asset under its own repository, with tag "ffmpeg":

    https://github.com/mcablylx/KtDownload/releases/tag/ffmpeg

This is a redistribution of the unmodified LGPL-licensed binary above; the
license, build configuration and copyright notices remain those of the FFmpeg
project and its build provider.

SHA-256 of the vendored ffmpeg.exe:
    5a11d3d34496b6d4b3cedf0230739ddc3d2710c0ac58637ae134df801238d503

Verify locally with:
    certutil -hashfile ffmpeg.exe SHA256
    # or on Git Bash:  sha256sum ffmpeg.exe

Build configuration (verified: --enable-version3, no --enable-gpl / --enable-nonfree):
    --prefix=/ffbuild/prefix --pkg-config-flags=--static --pkg-config=pkg-config
    --cross-prefix=x86_64-w64-mingw32- --arch=x86_64 --target-os=mingw32
    --enable-version3 --disable-debug --disable-w32threads --enable-pthreads
    --enable-iconv --enable-zlib --enable-libxml2 --enable-libvmaf
    --enable-fontconfig --enable-libharfbuzz --enable-libfreetype
    --enable-libfribidi --enable-lcms2 --enable-vulkan --enable-libshaderc
    --enable-libdav1d --enable-libvorbis --enable-librav1e --enable-librsvg
    --enable-gmp --enable-lzma --enable-liblcevc-dec --enable-opencl --enable-amf
    --enable-libaom --enable-chromaprint --enable-libaribb24 --enable-libaribcaption
    --enable-libass --enable-libbluray --enable-libjxl --enable-libmp3lame
    --enable-libopus --enable-libplacebo --enable-librist --enable-libssh
    --enable-libtheora --enable-libvpx --enable-libwebp --enable-libzmq --enable-lv2
    --enable-libvpl --enable-openal --enable-liboapv --enable-libopencore-amrnb
    --enable-libopencore-amrwb --enable-libopenh264 --enable-libopenjpeg
    --enable-libopenmpt --enable-schannel --enable-sdl2 --enable-libsnappy
    --enable-libsoxr --enable-libsrt --enable-libsvtav1 --enable-libtwolame
    --enable-libuavs3d --enable-vaapi --enable-vapoursynth --enable-libzimg
    --enable-libzvbi --extra-version=20261024
    # NOTE: --disable-libx264 / --disable-libx265 / --disable-libxvid are explicit.
    # --enable-version3 upgrades the license to LGPL-3.0-or-later.
    # No --enable-gpl / --enable-nonfree present; this is an LGPL v3 build.


LGPL compliance notes
---------------------
1. This file + LICENSE.txt (LGPL v3 full text) are distributed alongside ffmpeg.exe
   (see ../LICENSE.txt and the copy shipped in resources/common/ffmpeg/).
   The upstream LICENSE.LGPL-2.1.txt is also shipped for completeness.
   Per-platform binaries live in resources/windows/ffmpeg/ (this file) and
   resources/macos/ffmpeg/ (built on macOS by scripts/fetch-ffmpeg-macos.sh).
2. The complete corresponding source is available at the URLs above.
3. ffmpeg.exe is shipped as a standalone file under <install-dir>\resources\ffmpeg\
   and is NOT integrity-checked or encrypted, so users may replace it with their
   own build (see README.md).
4. KtDownload invokes ffmpeg.exe as a separate process. No FFmpeg library is
   linked into the application, therefore KtDownload is not a derivative work
   under the LGPL.

Verify the shipped binary is an LGPL build:

    ffmpeg -version
    # first line: ffmpeg version n8.1.3-24-g92611900bb-20261024 ...
    ffmpeg -version | findstr configuration
    # the configuration line MUST contain --enable-version3
    # and MUST NOT contain --enable-gpl or --enable-nonfree
